static_traits.name: Li Rui
static_traits.family_status: Not mentioned specific family member details
static_traits.social_status: Have a few relatives and friends supporting, but have not yet discussed dating Anxiety with them; after Divorce, social life and Romantic relationship affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past; no similar psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Positive attitude, clear expression, able to identify and willing to challenge automatic thoughts, highly cooperative; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Due to Divorce, persistent Anxiety when reconsidering dating, believing potential partners will mind because of it, leading to avoidance of dating and romantic socializing, which affects social life and self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Hope to resolve and overcome Divorce-related dating Anxiety, improving social life and self-esteem.
growth_experiences: After Divorce began considering dating again, gradually developing distrust of potential partners, worrying about being judged as a 'failure' or 'problematic'. Whenever thinking of dating or romantic socializing, strong Anxiety arises and avoidance is chosen, negatively affecting social life and overall well-being; although Work performance is not yet affected, pursuit of intimate relationships is significantly blocked.

core_beliefs: I have problems/I am not good enough (Divorce means I am defective)

special_situations.event: Considering concrete situations of attending matchmaking or dating again (such as planning a first meeting with a stranger)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person knows I am divorced, they will definitely evaluate me negatively, thinking I am a failure or have problems
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing the risk of being judged by avoiding dating and romantic socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He / she will be troubled by my divorce and look down on me

special_situations.event: The preparation stage shortly before a blind date, or the moment of just starting to consider dating
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If judged or rejected, my self-esteem and future relationships will both suffer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries rationalization and self-comfort (positive self-talk), but still continues to avoid
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: A date will surely mind my divorce and reject me

special_situations.event: Recalling the divorce experience and connecting it with future relationship prospects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Divorce equals failure, meaning I am not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing, shifting energy to Work, avoiding deep discussion of this Anxiety with relatives and friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My failed marriage shows I have problems, there will not be good outcomes

special_situations.event: A friend offered 'many people Divorce, no need to worry' as normalizing feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if someone encourages or supports, this positive information is not enough to change the fact (others will still mind)
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or downplays others' positive feedback, stays vigilant and avoids dating
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Their saying 'no need to worry' is useless too, dating prospects will still mind

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized and to build safe intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged/rejected because of Divorce and failing again, leading to Impaired self-esteem
defense_goal: Staying distant to avoid hurt and shame
Reduce the risk of being negated through avoidance
Maintaining a sense of psychological control through rationalization and presetting others' negative evaluations

object_relations.self_representation: A 'failure' and 'problematic Divorcee' who may face Being rejected
object_relations.object_representation: Potential partners with criticism and pickiness (ready to judge/negate me at any time)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When topics of dating or being evaluated by others come up, or the counselor invites them to examine evidence and challenge thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others (including the counselor/potential partner) will judge oneself like in past relationships and see oneself as a failure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use a cautious and defensive tone, repeatedly emphasizing worry about others' negative views, indirectly expressing insecurity while avoiding directly exposing vulnerability; encourage gently probing evidence, maintaining a supportive tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to date or take contact exercises (e.g. Role playing)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Views the decision to avoid and delay dating as a 'rational arrangement', to reduce tension and risk
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calmly and methodically present various practical reasons (busy, timing not yet right) to delay action; the counselor responds with Empathy and gently Confrontation its avoidance function.

manifestations: After divorce, avoids contact in intimate relationships, worried about being judged as a failure
Strong Anxiety when reconsidering dating, reduced romantic socializing
not yet deeply discussed dating Anxiety with relatives and friends, maintaining psychological distance
outcomes: Restricted social life and Increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly evaluates oneself as 'a failure/problematic', presuming others' negative views
Overly cautious when considering dating, tending toward Self-denial and Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turn energy originally directed at dating and intimate connection into a cycle of self-Anxiety and self-comfort
Avoid dating to 'protect myself', not reaching out or seeking support

exception_events.target_problem: In situations involving discussing Divorce or considering dating, the client usually predicts others' negative evaluations and experiences Anxiety and avoidance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once when talking with a friend, the friend gave normalizing and supportive feedback: 'many people Divorce, no need to worry'; at that moment I was not yet judged, and Anxiety loosened somewhat.
exception_events.reason: Different support: normalizing and affirming information from friends; a safer situation and higher relationship trust, enabling the client to receive alternative views.

positive_force: Has a few trustworthy family and friends as support resources
Work performance stable (emergency department Work not yet affected), possessing Self-efficacy
Willing to try challenging negative automatic thoughts and adopting alternative perspectives
Able to identify and affirm own strengths (support, diligence, Humor)
negative_force: Jumping to conclusions and catastrophizing (mind reading, predicting the future)
Overgeneralizing divorce as self-failure, forming a negative core belief
Avoid dating and romantic socializing to escape judgment, leading to a reinforced Sense of isolation
not yet actively expressed to or sought help from the support system, positive feedback hard to internalize

target_behavior.behavior: High Anxiety arises when considering or approaching dating/blind dates, choosing avoidance
antecedent: Thinking of the connection between Divorce and future romantic relationships
Planning or approaching a first meeting with a stranger (matchmaking/date)
Facing others' possible evaluations or when the topic of divorce comes up
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic predictions and mind reading about others' reactions (assuming the other will mind Divorce and see me as a failure), overgeneralizing Divorce as 'I have problems/not worthy of being loved'.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential judgment and rejection to maintain fragile self-esteem and a sense of psychological safety.
target_behavior.consequence: Restricted social life, Increased sense of isolation, Decreased self-esteem, continuously reinforcing the vicious cycle of Anxiety and avoidance.
